justifications.type_expressiveness: Good use of enums for Value, Expr, BinOp, and EvalError variants, but TypeError carries a String payload rather than structured type information.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enums with the three required distinguishing variants, no panics in library paths, but the unwrap on str::from_utf8 and TypeError's stringly payload prevent a 3.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Required Display/Debug impls and basic derives are present, but there are zero doc comments on any public item and no Error trait impls.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, matches!, recursive descent, and a linked-list Env nicely, though some clones and a manual byte-indexed tokenizer loop keep it from feeling polished.
